title: Number of Nodes in the Sub-Tree With the Same Label
summary: Given a tree with n nodes numbered from 0 to n-1 , where each node has a label represented by a character in the string labels, and edges connecting the nodes, return an array of size n .
statement: Given a tree with n nodes numbered from 0 to n-1 , where each node has a label represented by a character in the string labels, and edges connecting the nodes, return an array of size n . Each element in the array represents the count of nodes in the subtree rooted at the i -th node that share the same label as the i -th node. The edges are provided as pairs of node indices.
constraints: The undirected edges form a tree rooted at node zero.
For each node, count nodes in its rooted subtree carrying the same label.
hints: Root the tree at zero with a DFS.
Return a 26-slot label-frequency array from each subtree.
Merge child arrays, add the current label, and record its resulting frequency.
Postorder aggregation includes every descendant exactly once and excludes everything outside the rooted subtree.
editorial: Postorder aggregation includes every descendant exactly once and excludes everything outside the rooted subtree.

tests.explanation: Node zero and descendant two share a; every other node has one matching label in its subtree.
The subtree sizes are four, two, one, and one because every label is b.
